During the last two decades, Internet has really revolutionized the way companies provide their products and services to their clients. Creating of new technologies, together with dynamic and responsive websites have ended up in one of the most powerful tools nowadays; web applications.</br>
Web application development is taking the world by storm; it helps enterprises with robust and strong web applications, which facilitate the direct contact between the business and the client. </br>

For many years, the customer had to install software and keep in touch with the company to know if there was an update, patch or error in the program. Now, the customer is not required to install any software. Connecting to the internet and downloading the app are more than enough. This saves the customer efforts, and the companies have absolute control over the entire app, and these can make changes or rectify errors as they pleased, which is highly cost effective and time-saving.</br>

Since PHP was created, it has been world-renowned in the web application development, thanks to the benefits it brings: Apps in PHP are safe and stable. These seldom crash or malfunction because it has a solid core and a secure architecture.</br>
On the other hand, being open source and free helps companies to save a considerable amount of money; despite of  the quality because it is not compromised at all. Perhaps, the biggest advantage is that PHP is able to run across major web browsers and operating systems like google chrome, Mac IOS, and Android, so it can be used in desktops and smartphones alike.
